title: 19-Year-Old Drunk Driver Tries To Impress Girlfriend, Gets OWI
description:
On March 7, 2021, a 19-year-old drunk man drove 100 mph down a residential street resulting in a car wreck. He faces a felony charge of first-degree recklessly endangering safety and misdemeanor charges of second-offense drunk driving, second-offense operating with prohibited blood-alcohol content, and operating after revocation.
